note: Washington County, Idaho publishes no queryable zoning district layer. The county's zoning is a 2020 assessor zoning map PDF. Weiser's zoning is only JPG map images on cityofweiser.net. Cambridge posts its zoning map on a web page with no service. The only ArcGIS zoning hits (ZONING_113023_(2) on the Idaho Tax Commission folder) cover other counties such as Owyhee and Payette, not Washington County. Commercial parcel files with zoning fields are paid and not official.
